title: [BUG] Claude breaks when interrupted while using certain tools
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
- Claude CLI version: Latest
- Operating System: Ubuntu 22.04
- Terminal:  Termius

## Bug Description
If I interrupt Claude Code while it's using some tools, it returns an API error and then the conversation cannot continue.  Any further input just results in an API error.  I have to use the /clear command before the API responds again.  It doesn't seem to happen when it's just "thinking" ... more so when it's showing that it is using a tool

Yes, I realise a screenshot of a copy and paste of the API error would help... but I wanted to get this bug report started first and I'll add to it the next time it happens
author: tlc-ben-quinn
